descriptions.w3d_d30g_weapon_slots_80068eac: First person weapon slots: for each of eight slots clears the two flags and two names at +120/+160 and +240/+280 and sets the two indices +200 and +320 to -1, takes the slot's two names from the weapon record (slots 1 to 7; empty for slot 0) and marks each slot and stores each name that is not empty.
